pages.title: Atlas - internal deployment tool
pages.body:
Atlas is the internal deployment tool for the Atlas rollout.
It is owned and maintained by the ops team.
Current stable release: 1.2.0.

pages.title: Atlas documentation
pages.body:
Guides for installing, configuring and operating Atlas.
Start with the installation guide, then the configuration guide.

pages.title: Installing Atlas
pages.body:
Atlas requires Python 3.11 or newer and runs on Linux and macOS.
Install with: pip install atlas-cli
Then run `atlas init` once per project.
After installing, set the values described in the configuration guide.

pages.title: Configuring Atlas
pages.body:
Configuration lives in app.json.
retries: number of deploy retries, default 3.
timeout_s: per-step timeout in seconds, default 30.
env: deployment environment name, default staging.
Quotas that apply to every environment are listed on the limits page.

pages.title: Atlas rate limits and quotas
pages.body:
API requests: 600 per minute per API key.
Concurrent deployments: 5 per project.
Webhook delivery retries: 8 attempts with exponential backoff (raised from 5 in release 1.2.0).
Last reviewed 2026-04-02.

pages.title: Atlas changelog
pages.body:
Release history for Atlas.
1.2.0 (2026-03-14): Added export to CSV and Parquet. Webhook retry limit raised from 5 to 8.
1.1.0 (2025-11-20): Fixed login bug affecting SSO users.
1.0.0 (2025-06-01): First stable release.

pages.title: Atlas pricing
pages.body:
Team plan: $40 per seat per month, billed annually. Includes 5 concurrent deployments.
Enterprise plan: custom pricing, contact sales@atlas.example.
Prices effective 2026-02-01. The 2025 price list has been retired.

pages.title: Atlas 1.2.0 released
pages.body:
Posted 2026-03-14 by Priya Natarajan, release manager.
Atlas 1.2.0 adds export to CSV and Parquet and raises the webhook retry limit to 8.
Upgrade with: pip install --upgrade atlas-cli
Full details are in the changelog.

pages.title: Atlas (community wiki)
pages.body:
Atlas is an internal deployment tool. This page is maintained by volunteers; last edited 2025-11-02.
Maintainer: platform team.
Webhook delivery retries: 5 attempts.
A mirror of the official limits page is kept at mirror.example.
See the FAQ for platform support questions.

pages.title: Atlas FAQ
pages.body:
Q: Does Atlas run on Windows? A: No. Atlas supports Linux and macOS only.
Q: Which Python version is required? A: See the official installation guide.
Q: Who do I contact about billing? A: The pricing page lists the sales contact.

pages.title: Atlas service status
pages.body:
All systems operational as of 2026-10-01.
Last incident: 2026-09-18, webhook delivery delays, duration 42 minutes.
Uptime over the last 90 days: 99.95%.

pages.title: Incident 2026-09-18: webhook delivery delays
pages.body:
Duration: 42 minutes (09:12 to 09:54 UTC).
Root cause: an expired TLS certificate on the webhook relay.
Action items: automate certificate renewal; add expiry alerting 14 days ahead.

pages.title: Review: Atlas deployment tool
pages.body:
Published 2026-01-10.
Atlas is a solid internal deployment tool. The Team plan costs $35 per seat per month.
Export is limited to CSV; Parquet support is promised for a later release.
Verdict: recommended for small ops teams.
